correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the all-n static theorem from forest acyclicity and the connected graph of topological orders under adjacent incomparable transpositions: a forest orientation has a unique extension precisely when the edges form a directed spanning path. The two traversals have the same inversion parity exactly for n=0,1 modulo 4; Cayley and a label-swap involution give T_n. The finite adaptive recurrence W(H,d) is exact and full-tree feasibility is tested for n<=7. A separate independent bit-mask version-space recursion produced Littlestone depths (0,0,1,3,5,8,10), including nonattainability of depth 11 at n=7. The source verifier and complete witness format were inspected, not assumed correct from logged PASS; no adaptive claim beyond n=7.
